name: Claude (Anthropic)
enables: Use Claude models for coding and analysis through supported connection methods, billed to your own Anthropic account.

name: OpenAI
enables: Use OpenAI models for coding and analysis with your own API key.

name: Google Gemini
enables: Use Gemini models for coding and analysis with your own API key.

name: OpenAI-compatible endpoints
enables: Connect any service or gateway that speaks the OpenAI chat API by entering its address and key.

name: OpenRouter
enables: Reach many hosted models behind one key.

name: BytePlus ModelArk
enables: Use ModelArk models directly, where the service's terms allow it.

name: Ollama
enables: Run open models on your own machine and use them offline, at no cost per token.

name: LM Studio
enables: Use the models you have loaded in LM Studio, entirely on your machine.

name: llama.cpp-compatible servers
enables: Use a local model server you run yourself.

name: Claude Code accounts
enables: Use a Claude Code subscription you already pay for, where a supported sign-in method exists.

name: Codex accounts
enables: Use a Codex subscription you already pay for, where a supported sign-in method exists.

name: Gemini CLI accounts
enables: Use a Gemini CLI account you already have, where a supported sign-in method exists.

name: SSH remotes
enables: Open a shell on a remote machine in a Vekrun tab, with the host's key checked before you connect.

name: Remote workers
enables: Run agent tasks on a machine you control so they keep going after you close your laptop.
note: A headless worker runs unattended on this machine; running it on another machine you control is next.

name: Language servers
enables: Get diagnostics and navigation in the built-in editor for languages with a language server.

name: Custom MCP servers
enables: Give agents access to any MCP server you configure, with permissions you set per server.
note: Remote and local servers with per-server permissions; every call asks.

name: Linear
enables: Turn assigned issues into coding sessions and send status back when you deliver.
note: Connection and sync are built and tested against recorded responses; not yet run against the live service.

name: Jira
enables: Work on tickets and update their progress without leaving the terminal.
note: Connection and sync are built and tested against recorded responses; not yet run against the live service.

name: Asana
enables: See your Asana tasks on the Board and start work from any of them.
note: Connection and sync are built and tested against recorded responses; not yet run against the live service.

name: GitHub Issues
enables: Bring issues assigned to you onto the Board alongside tickets from other tools.
note: Connection and sync are built and tested against recorded responses; not yet run against the live service.

name: GitLab Issues
enables: Bring GitLab issues onto the Board and link merge requests back to them.
note: Connection and sync are built and tested against recorded responses; not yet run against the live service.

name: Confluence
enables: Let agents read the specs and pages behind your tickets.

name: Notion
enables: Let agents read and update the Notion pages your work refers to.

name: Git
enables: Stage, diff, commit, branch, stash and manage worktrees using the git you already have installed, so your hooks keep working.

name: GitHub
enables: Review pull requests, manage code, and link changes to tasks.
note: Issues, link-back comments and sign-in are built and tested against recorded responses; the pull-request inbox is planned.

name: GitLab
enables: Review merge requests, manage code, and link changes to issues.
note: Issues, merge-request link-back and sign-in with your own application id are built and tested against recorded responses; live use not yet verified.

name: Honeybadger
enables: Investigate application errors and turn incidents into development work.
note: Errors, occurrences and projects are read through the Data API and tested against recorded responses; not yet run against a live account.

name: Sentry
enables: Analyze errors and performance problems, then plan or delegate fixes.
note: Issues, events and performance problems are read through the API and tested against recorded responses; not yet run against a live organisation.

name: Datadog
enables: Examine traces, latency, and application health to identify bottlenecks.
note: Error tracking, monitors and slowest endpoints by p95 are read through the API and tested against recorded responses; trace search is not claimed until verified live.

name: AppSignal
enables: Investigate exceptions, slow requests, and performance regressions.
note: Apps, exception and performance incidents and samples are read through the API and tested against recorded responses; not yet run against a live account.

name: Slack
enables: Let agents read the threads behind a task and post updates where your team works.

name: Figma
enables: Let agents read the designs a ticket refers to.
note: Depends on Figma listing Vekrun as a client.

name: PostgreSQL
enables: Let agents inspect a database schema and run read queries you approve.

name: Cloudflare
enables: Inspect and manage Cloudflare resources from a session, with your permission.

name: Supabase
enables: Inspect and manage Supabase projects from a session, with your permission.

name: Stripe
enables: Look up Stripe objects while debugging payment code, with your permission.
